spec.goal: I can understand and write simple introductions that describe myself and my family.

topics.title: Listening: Introductions and Family Descriptions
topics.covers: Listen to short personal profiles and extract names, ages, origins, jobs, and family details.

topics.title: Reading a Short Personal Profile
topics.covers: Read a simple profile, use cognates and context to understand it, and answer factual questions.

topics.title: Writing: An About Me Paragraph
topics.covers: Write six to eight simple sentences about yourself and your family with correct agreement and accents.

topics.title: The Hispanic World: Countries and Capitals
topics.covers: Locate the 20 Spanish-speaking countries and their capitals, and learn which regions call themselves latinos or hispanos.

topics.title: Famous Hispanic Figures
topics.covers: Introduce well-known people from music, sport, and science using ser, nationality, and profession, such as Shakira es colombiana.

spec.convo: You and the partner each hold a different part of a host family profile; share facts to complete it.

phrases.es: Mi padre trabaja en un hotel.
en: My father works in a hotel.
My dad works in a hotel.

phrases.es: Madrid es la capital de España.
en: Madrid is the capital of Spain.

phrases.es: Bogotá es la capital de Colombia.
en: Bogotá is the capital of Colombia.

phrases.es: Costa Rica es un país pequeño.
en: Costa Rica is a small country.
Rafael Nadal is a Spanish tennis player.
Rafael Nadal is a tennis player from Spain.

lines.es: Mara y Tomás completan el perfil de una familia.
lines.en: Mara and Tomás are completing a family's profile.

lines.es: Me llamo Mara y soy de Chicago.
lines.en: My name is Mara and I'm from Chicago.

lines.es: Yo soy Tomás. Vivo en México con mi familia.
lines.en: I'm Tomás. I live in Mexico with my family.

lines.es: Mi madre es doctora y mi padre trabaja en un hotel.
lines.en: My mother is a doctor and my father works in a hotel.

lines.es: Tengo dos hermanos. Mi hermana se llama Ana.
lines.en: I have two brothers. My sister's name is Ana.

lines.es: Mi madre es de Colombia y es cantante.
lines.en: My mother is from Colombia and she is a singer.
Great! We're writing the profile now.

questions.question: How many siblings does Tomás have?

convo.setting: A school exchange video call. You each have half of your host family's profile and share facts to complete it.
convo.learnerCard: You have your host family's facts: the mother is a doctor, there are two brothers, and the family lives in Mexico.
convo.learnerCardEs: Tú tienes la otra parte del perfil. Habla de tu nombre, tu ciudad, tus hermanos y el trabajo de tu madre.
convo.partnerCard: Mara has the other half: the names, the city of the family, and the father's job.

goals.text: Greet Mara and say your name (Me llamo…).
Say where you are from (Soy de…).
Say how many brothers or sisters you have (Tengo dos hermanos.).
Say what your mother's job is (Mi madre es doctora.).

script.reply: ¡Qué bien! Yo soy de Chicago. ¿Tienes hermanos?

nudges.g4: Di el trabajo de tu madre: «Mi madre es…»

reads.passage: Me llamo Sara. Vivo en Chicago con mi familia. Mi madre es doctora y tengo dos hermanos.
reads.question: What is Sara's mother's job?
